title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
content:
arXiv:2609.35855v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Optimizing deployed AI systems increasingly amounts to editing prompts, skills, harnesses, and code rather than model weights. Existing approaches commonly optimize these artifacts through propose-evaluate-select procedures, where candidate configurations are evaluated and only those meeting an acceptance criterion are selected. Yet our analysis shows that discarded candidates often contain information critical for subsequent optimization. Discarding them causes later proposals to revisit the same failure modes. We introduce Mara Chain, a refinement procedure that turns rejected candidates into stepping stones. Rather than discarding a rejected candidate, Mara Chain retains and iteratively refines it using evidence accumulated across preceding attempts. The procedure limits each refinement chain to a fixed depth and applies Pareto-filtered Top-N selection to bound the candidate pool. Across AppWorld skill optimization, TerminalBench 2.1
author: Yubin Lyu, Fu Li, Jiawei Fei, Yang Zhao, Weixing Mei, Yinan Wu
summary_zh: 论文提出 Mara Chain，用于优化提示词、技能（skills）、harness 和代码等 AI 系统配置。传统的「提出-评估-筛选」流程会直接丢弃不达标的候选方案，Mara Chain 则保留这些被拒绝的候选，并利用之前积累的证据对它们逐步改进，避免后续优化重复掉进同样的失败模式。这一思路可以借鉴到 Claude Code 中 CLAUDE.md、skills 和 prompt 的迭代优化上。

Anchor the PreToolUse and PostToolUseFailure MCP health-check matchers so non-MCP tool calls do not spawn the health hook.
author: santhiprakash
summary_zh: everything-claude-code 仓库修复了 Hook 配置：给 PreToolUse 和 PostToolUseFailure 中做 MCP 健康检查的 matcher 加上锚定，只有调用 MCP 工具时才会触发健康检查 Hook。这样非 MCP 工具调用不会再白白启动 Hook 进程，开销更小。可以作为编写 Claude Code Hook matcher 时限定匹配范围的参考。
